<!-- name: Power-Up -->
<!-- board: Legends catch fire instead of wearing a top hat | a wizard outfit behind a magic word | the master unlock lights the aura too -->
**Power-Up.** For five hundred catches, the reward used to be a very small top hat. Squachy has been holding his tongue about that hat for a long time. It had to be balanced on every costume by hand, it sat on top of the other hats like a stack of plates, and to fit the whole thing on screen he had to shrink a tenth smaller than everyone else. The reward for being a Legend was being shorter. He has thrown it in the river.

<p align="center"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skizzophrenic/SquachWatch-CYD/v1.27.0/docs/power-up.gif" width="480" alt="Squachy on his main screen wrapped in a sheet of blue flame that fades to gold at the edges, on two backgrounds. Then the TERMINAL background with the word XYZZY boxed on both sides, tapped until a hollow voice says YZZERD. Then Squachy as a wizard in a purple robe, beard and pointed hat, first plain and then on fire, and the APPEARANCE settings page with the AURA row set to LIT."></p>

**The aura.** A Legend now gets one big sheet of fire wrapped around him, from one foot, up over his head and down to the other. It's deep blue where it touches him and fades out through azure, ice and pale yellow to gold licks at the edge, which climb up both sides like a proper flame should. Nothing sits on his head, so he's back to full size, and it fits every costume without anybody measuring anything. It has moods, because he does: catch something and it stands half as tall again, flickers twice as fast and throws rings of light along the floor. Let him nod off and it sinks to a low blue pilot light. Squad visitors are drawn in their own outfit and don't borrow your fire. It costs no extra memory and about four kilobytes of flash.

**AURA, LIT or OUT.** The TOP HAT row on SETTINGS > APPEARANCE is now AURA. If you'd taken the hat off, the aura still starts lit, because you never said anything about fire. Give it a look first, then put it out if it's too much.

**The master unlock lights it too.** "Give me everything" now really means everything. It only adds the aura, though: his colours stay at whatever stage he's actually earned.

**YZZERD.** Every so often, something on the TERMINAL background types a word. Old adventurers will know which one. Tap it, and nothing happens. Tap it again, and nothing happens, but more suspiciously. Tap it a third time and a hollow voice tells you his new name. YZZERD is a full wizard: a purple robe with gold trim, sleeves that keep up with his arms, a beard down to his belt, a tall pointed hat with a star on it, and a little orb of magic that orbits him and changes with his mood. He also takes the very last outfit slot the squad radio has, so the next costume is going to have to fight him for it.

### The actually-useful part

**Added**
- The Legend's aura (500 lifetime catches): a sheet of blue-to-gold flame drawn behind him, taller and faster when startled, low and blue when asleep. Your own Squachy only; visitors don't get it.
- AURA (LIT / OUT) on SETTINGS > APPEARANCE, shown once he's a Legend or after the master unlock. Starts lit, even if the top hat was off.
- YZZERD, a wizard outfit: tap XYZZY three times when it appears on the TERMINAL background. Three hints on that background, like the other hidden outfits.
- Console: XYZZY (puts the word up now) and LEGEND (wears the Legend look until the next boot).

**Changed**
- The top hat is gone. Legends are drawn full size again instead of a tenth smaller.
- The master unlock also lights the aura. It doesn't change his growth stage.
- The outfit gallery in the README shows all fifteen costumes.
